It used to be a secret known only to smugglers and [[corsair]]s. Now the [[Kournan military]] heavily patrols this area. ==Getting there== Your character must have completed the [[Moddok Crevice]] mission to be able to enter this area. If entering from the [[Moddok Crevice (outpost)|Moddok Crevice]] [[mission outpost]], talk to [[Gatekeeper Kahno]] to gain entry. ==Notes== *This area does not contribute to the Elonian [[Cartographer]] title track because it is considered underground (i.e. not uncovered on the [[world map]]). *{{Vanquisher|count = 281|low = 258|high = 304}} **There are several hidden groups of mandragors in the northeastern portion of the area. It is advised to start from [[Wehhan Terraces]] and work your way through the foes counter-clockwise to avoid [[popup]]s. **The mandragor boss, [[Joknang Earthturner]], appears to be alone, however upon approaching him several mandragors will [[spawn]]. If you approach slowly, there is a chance that only half the mandragors will spawn. **The sole [[Skale]] group in the area is led by [[Armind the Balancer]]. Before taking them on, take note of the nearby [[heket]] groups. At least two small heket groups have patrol paths that go very near the large Skale group. ==Trivia== *This area and [[The Hidden City of Ahdashim]] are the only explorable areas that do not contribute to the Cartographer title track and can be vanquished. {{Explorable areas in Kourna}} [[Category:Has Lightbringer bounties]] [[Category:Has Sunspear bounties]] [[de:Bahdok-Höhlen]]
